hero.title: Make the world happy, from Kobe.
hero.subtitle: Wholesale used clothing and leatherwear, plus OEM production. We leverage our production base in Pakistan and Thailand to deliver low-cost, small-lot, easy-to-use service.

slides.title: Used Clothing Wholesaler
slides.body: Pakistan is a major hub for used clothing gathered from Europe and the US. From vintage rarities to well-known brands, we offer custom remakes and resizing on request.

slides.title: Leather Garment and Leather Product Wholesaler
slides.body: Pakistan is one of the world's leading producers of lamb leather. Our own factory keeps production in-house, delivering strong quality at a competitive cost.

slides.title: A Trade Network Across 3 Countries
slides.body: Our head office in Kobe, an office in Bangkok, and our own factory in Karachi form a network connecting Japan, Thailand, and Pakistan.

slides.title: Small-Lot OEM Production
slides.body: Original production available from just 50 pieces. We support everything from planning and sampling to inspection, customs clearance, and delivery.

slides.title: Sharing the Joy of Production, Widely
slides.body: By basing production in regions affected by conflict and hardship, we create local jobs and fair trade opportunities while delivering real value to our customers in Japan.

slides.title: A Wide Range Of Brands
slides.body: From household names to rare vintage finds, our used clothing lineup covers a broad and ever-changing range.

slides.title: Two Warehouses In Kobe
slides.body: Our Nagata and Arino warehouses give us stable inventory management and fast, reliable shipping.

slides.title: Also Available on Online Marketplaces
slides.body: Our products are available on Rakuten Ichiba and Yahoo! Shopping, reaching customers across Japan without a physical storefront.

highlights.title: A Compact Operation
highlights.body: We keep production, wholesale, and retail in a simple, streamlined structure — fast, responsive, and free of unnecessary overhead.

highlights.title: Low Cost, Small Lots
highlights.body: Our production base in Pakistan lets us offer low costs and small minimum order quantities.

highlights.title: Remake & Resize on Request
highlights.body: Used clothing sourced from Europe and the US can be freely customized with distressing, washing, embroidery, dyeing, and printing.

highlights.title: Reliable Quality Control
highlights.body: An in-house factory means consistent quality control, from planning through final inspection and shipping.

hero.title: Business
hero.subtitle: We keep production, wholesale, and retail as simple as possible.

business.intro: Under the concept of staying "compact," JTP Trading's business rests on three pillars: used clothing wholesale, remake garments wholesale, and leather wholesale. Our production base in Pakistan lets us offer low costs, small lots, and easy-to-use service.

usedClothing.title: Used Clothing Wholesaler
usedClothing.body: Pakistan is a major collection point for used clothing — mountains of it gathered from the US and Europe. We handle everything from well-known brands to rare vintage finds, and offer custom remakes to your specification: distressing, washing, embroidery, dyeing, and printing.

remake.title: Remake Garments Wholesaler
remake.body: Every piece can be tailored to your specification — distressing, washing, embroidery, dyeing, printing, and resizing — turning standard denim, military gear, tees, and knitwear into a fully original product line.

leather.title: Leather Garment and Leather Product Wholesaler
leather.body: Pakistan's thriving livestock industry makes it one of the world's premier sources of lamb leather. Production at our own local factory keeps costs down without compromising quality. We work with riders jackets, bags, and more, across lambskin, suede, cowhide, goat leather, and faux leather.

business.infrastructure: We operate two warehouses in Hyogo Prefecture — Nagata and Arino — alongside our Thailand and Pakistan offices, which serve as bases for OEM production and sourcing.
business.brandsBody: From household names to rare vintage finds, we handle a wide range of used clothing brands.

hero.title: OEM Production
hero.subtitle: From planning to customs clearance and delivery — one-stop OEM at our own factory.

oem.intro: By handling planning, production, and sales entirely in-house, JTP Trading delivers high-quality, original products at low cost. We support the full process: product planning, sampling, quality inspection, shipping to Japan, customs clearance, and final delivery.
oem.minOrderBody: We accept orders from as few as 50 pieces per style, available in 2 sizes and 2 colors. Custom colorways are also available starting at 50 pieces.

leatherCapability.title: Leather Garments and Products
leatherCapability.body: Riders jackets, bags, and fully custom leather goods, across lambskin, suede, cowhide, goat leather, and faux leather.

remakeCapability.title: Remake Garments
remakeCapability.body: Denim, military pieces, t-shirts, and knitwear — freely customizable with distressing, washing, embroidery, dyeing, and printing.

process.title: Planning & Consultation
process.body: We discuss materials and design direction together and shape the initial plan.

process.title: Sampling & Quotes
process.body: Review the sample and quote, and once approved, we move into full production.

process.title: Production & Inspection
process.body: Production happens at our own factory, with quality inspection before shipping.

process.title: Customs & Delivery
process.body: We handle shipping to Japan and customs clearance, delivering the finished goods to you.

hero.title: Company
hero.subtitle: Make the world happy, from Kobe/Japan.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: We build our business on skilled hands in Pakistan — a country with deep roots in leatherwork and textile craft. By creating stable local jobs and trading fairly, we help that skill translate into real economic independence, while bringing genuine value to our customers in Japan. That's what it means to share the joy of production.

message.title: A Message From Our President
message.body: We insist on small-lot production because we want to share the joy of making things with as many people as possible. We'll keep working carefully, one step at a time, to deliver happiness to our customers at a fair price.
message.name: Shinobu Kanbe, President
